svg.title: Example: Value Stream Map
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape value stream map: scope, six process steps with wait triangles and a timeline ladder, totals including flow efficiency, future state ideas, and an improvement plan.
svg.text: Map every step from request to customer, see where work waits, and design a faster future state.
Manage Flow · Inspired by Lean Value Stream Mapping (Rother & Shook) · Wait vs. Work Time · Flow Efficiency
ONE STREAM, ONE TYPE OF WORK
PROCESS STEPS LEFT TO RIGHT · WAITS BETWEEN THEM
FLOW EFFICIENCY = WORK TIME / LEAD TIME
REMOVE WAITS · REDUCE HAND-OFFS · BUILD QUALITY IN
“What would it take to halve the lead time?”
Manage Flow · Stop Starting, Start Finishing
